text: Hello everyone, welcome to my class.This is the very first lesson of the new term.We are going to start a new book and a new unit.Unit one, feeling good.Today, we will focus on the reading part.Is chocolate the answer?By the end of this period, you are expected to identify the writer's point of view on happiness and summarize the factors that contribute to happiness presented by the writer.We tell the gist of the passage and answer the question, is chocolate the answer, in the title.You are also expected to analyze the causes of some negative emotions in your life and give advice accordingly.Before reading, please get your textbook and worksheets ready.What comes to your mind when speaking of happiness?Some of you might say delicious food and sweets like chocolate, money, good health, loving relationships, friendship.And some of you might say the latest gadget like fashionable smartphones and tablets.Yes, all these factors can bring happiness to most of us.But why?Is there any difference between the happiness brought by chocolate and that by friendship?Please open your books and turn to page six.Read the title and introductory paragraph to find out what we are going to read today.Yes, we are going to read a passage about the reasons for happiness.Why do we say so?Because this introductory paragraph consists of four questions among which what makes people happy and what's the secret are especially eye-catching clues.Can you make a guess what on cloud nine and down in the dumps mean?Yes, they mean happy and sad.But again, why do you say so?Because of the signal word wild, which is used to contrast two things, in this case, happiness and sadness, right?Now, please mark the four main paragraphs from one to four.Skin these four paragraphs to check whether you've made the right prediction.You will have 30 seconds.Yes, this passage does talk about the reasons for happiness.We can find clear clues in the first sentence of paragraph one and paragraph four.Now, please think about how many parts the whole passage can be divided into and why.Yes, we can divide the whole passage into two parts according to the topic sentence of paragraph one and paragraph two.In the first part, which is just paragraph one, the writer interprets his point that prosperity is not the main reason for happiness by referring to the latest world happiness report.In the second part, which covers paragraphs two to four, the writer explains his point that deep, long-lasting happiness comes from intangible things rather than things like chocolates and smartphones by mentioning three factors in three paragraphs respectively.First of all, let's focus on paragraph one.Please read paragraph one and answer the following questions.You will have two minutes for the
